task_scope: Authorized real-data fixed baseline, one conditional fit attempt and rejection evidence; not complete physiological calibration

review_condition_clarifications.heldout_task: Known heldout E/I waveforms to spikes in retained RGC module, not light-to-spike end-to-end prediction

primary_version_scope.methods_basis: Published open full text, not a claimed v1-PDF Methods verification
primary_version_scope.acquisition_source: Trong-Rieke2008 official NCBI BioC snapshot copied from supplied review

unclosed_fields.present: Current numeric arrays and polarity; pA is an explicit project interpretation
unclosed_fields.missing: Cell_6 official physical unit, ADC/amplifier calibration, export multiplier and sign definition
unclosed_fields.minimum_source: Cell_6 export README/code plus current-channel calibration/header

unclosed_fields.present: Increasing integers within the sample range; general Methods sampling0.1ms
unclosed_fields.missing: Actual spike-generation/export code; zero/one origin, original/decimated grid, sample reference and trigger time
unclosed_fields.minimum_source: SpikeTimes generation expression and Cell_6 sampling/trigger metadata

unclosed_fields.present: This analysis adds no offset subtraction or input gain
unclosed_fields.missing: Whether source export already removed holding/leak/capacitive/background current; per-trial offset values and selection windows
unclosed_fields.minimum_source: Export processing code or per-trial correction ledger, including explicit zero correction when applicable

unclosed_fields.present: Original acquisition paper examples: E hold -70mV, I hold approximately+15mV
unclosed_fields.missing: Command and actual/corrected Vhold for each Cell_6 E/I trial, recording mode and voltage reference

unclosed_fields.minimum_source: Cell_6 acquisition/correction metadata or an explicit mapping to the documented acquisition protocol

unclosed_fields.present: ExcStm/InhStm/SpikeStm exact full-vector identity and matching sample counts; source general timing0.1ms

unclosed_fields.present: Source label060908Bc2 and ON-parasol cohort identification; original acquisition paper includes multiple primate species
